import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, struct, fcntl, termios

def drain(master, dur=1.0):
    out = b""
    end = time.time() + dur
    while time.time() < end:
        r,_,_ = select.select([master],[],[],0.1)
        if r:
            try:
                d = os.read(master, 65536)
                if not d: break
                out += d
            except OSError:
                break
    return out.decode(errors="replace")

# Approach A: pty.openpty + Popen(start_new_session=True)
master, slave = pty.openpty()
fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 0, 0))
p = subprocess.Popen(["bash", "-i"], stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave,
                     start_new_session=True, close_fds=True,
                     env=dict(os.environ, TERM="xterm-256color"))
os.close(slave)
print("A initial:", repr(drain(master, 1.2)))
os.write(master, b"sleep 100\n")
time.sleep(0.6)
os.write(master, b"\x03")
time.sleep(0.6)
print("A after C-c:", repr(drain(master, 1.0)))
os.write(master, b"echo MARKER_A\n")
time.sleep(1.0)
print("A marker:", repr(drain(master, 1.0)))
os.write(master, b"jobs\n")
time.sl
